#| output: asis
# Builds the publication list from assets/publications.bib.
# To add a paper, add an entry to the .bib file and re-render.
import re
from pathlib import Path

BIB_FILE = Path("assets/publications.bib")


def read_braced(text, i):
    """Return (content, next_index) for a {...} group starting at text[i]."""
    depth, start = 0, i
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[i] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return text[start + 1 : i], i + 1
        i += 1
    raise ValueError("Unbalanced braces in .bib file")


def parse_fields(body):
    fields, i = {}, 0
    while i < len(body):
        m = re.compile(r"[\s,]*([A-Za-z_-]+)\s*=\s*").match(body, i)
        if not m:
            break
        name, i = m.group(1).lower(), m.end()
        if body[i] == "{":
            value, i = read_braced(body, i)
        elif body[i] == '"':
            end = body.index('"', i + 1)
            value, i = body[i + 1 : end], end + 1
        else:
            end = body.find(",", i)
            end = len(body) if end < 0 else end
            value, i = body[i:end], end
        fields[name] = " ".join(value.replace("{", "").replace("}", "").split())
    return fields


def parse_bib(text):
    entries, i = [], 0
    while (at := text.find("@", i)) >= 0:
        brace = text.find("{", at)
        body, i = read_braced(text, brace)
        _key, _, rest = body.partition(",")
        entries.append(parse_fields(rest))
    return entries


def format_authors(raw):
    names = []
    for name in re.split(r"\s+and\s+", raw):
        if "," in name:  # "Last, First" -> "First Last"
            last, first = [p.strip() for p in name.split(",", 1)]
            name = f"{first} {last}"
        names.append(name)
    return ", ".join(names)


def format_venue(e):
    venue = e.get("journal") or e.get("booktitle", "")
    parts = [f"*{venue}*"] if venue else []
    if vol := e.get("volume"):
        num = e.get("number") or e.get("issue")
        parts.append(f"{vol}({num})" if num else vol)
    if pages := e.get("pages"):
        parts.append(pages.replace("--", "–"))
    if year := e.get("year"):
        parts.append(year)
    return ", ".join(parts)


def link(e):
    if url := e.get("url"):
        return url
    if doi := e.get("doi"):
        return f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
    return None


entries = parse_bib(BIB_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
entries.sort(key=lambda e: int(e.get("year", 0)), reverse=True)

for e in entries:
    lines = [
        "::: {.pub}",
        f"[{e.get('title', '')}]{{.pub-title}}",
        f"[{format_authors(e.get('author', ''))}]{{.pub-authors}}",
        f"[{format_venue(e)}]{{.pub-venue}}",
    ]
    if href := link(e):
        lines.append(f'[[Paper]({href}){{target="_blank" rel="noopener"}}]{{.pub-links}}')
    lines.append(":::\n")
    print("\n".join(lines))
